name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 7 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2026-01-08, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
